n: καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.¶ (kai kuriou Iēsou Christou) 'and Lord Jesus Christ.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ αὐξανόμενον (kai auxanomenon) 'and increasing' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg) instead of ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+TR+Byz)
ἡμᾶς (hēmas) 'us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH)
διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, (dia tou aimatos autou) 'through the blood of him' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)

ἀποκατηλλάγητε (apokatēllagēte) 'you were reconciled' occurs in a few manuscripts (SBL) instead of ἀποκατήλλαξεν (apokatēllaxen) 'He has reconciled [You]' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+WH+Treg+TR+Byz)
Ἰησοῦ, (Iēsou) 'Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ (kai patros kai tou) 'and Father and the' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+TR+Byz)
τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν (tōn hamartiōn) 'of the sins' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
μὴ (mē) 'not' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (WH+TR+Byz) instead of ὑμῶν, (humōn) 'of you,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Χριστὸς (Christos) 'Christ' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κύριος (kurios) 'Lord' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
θεοῦ (theou) 'of God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'from Christ' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
κυρίῳ (kuriō) 'Lord' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of θεῷ· (theō) 'to God;' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἰδίοις (idiois) 'to [your] own' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
θεόν (theon) 'God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κύριον. (kurion) 'Lord.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
πᾶν (pan) 'everything' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
τι (ti) 'any [of]' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+Treg)
Ἰησοῦ, (Iēsou) 'Jesus,' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+WH+Treg)
ζῆλον (zēlon) 'zeal' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of πόνον (ponon) 'labour' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Νυμφᾶν (Numphan) 'Nymphas' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz) instead of Νύμφαν (Numphan) 'Nympha' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH)
αὐτοῦ (autou) 'of him' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz ¦ αὐτῶν (o=autōn) of them - G0846=P-GPM in: Tyn+Treg) instead of αὐτῆς (autēs) 'of her' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)

ἀμήν. πρός Κολασσαεῖς ἐγράφη ἀπό Ῥώμης διά τυχικοῦ καί Ὀνησίμου.¶ (amēn pros Kolassaeis egraphē apo Rhōmēs dia tuchikou kai Onēsimou) 'Amen. to Colossian it was written from Rome through Tychicus and Onesimus.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
